falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the 78% bottom_2024_aug pattern match, as that pattern resolved with lower lows; this proves the current structure is not a bottom but something else

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX compression to pre-crisis levels would falsify the bottom formation, as August 2024 bottom featured elevated volatility that gradually normalized; this signals complacency inconsistent with capitulation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts further to -75bps or wider (more negative)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion despite the purported bottom would invalidate the pattern, as the August 2024 bottom coincided with curve steepening (un-inversion); this shows recession risk is escalating, not resolving
